A '''city''' of towering buildings stood on the surface of the lush [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the year [[25,793 BBY]]. It was home to some of the world's native [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the forces of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] [[Conquest of Tatooine|invaded]] Tatooine and set [[Fire/Legends|fire]] to the [[City/Legends|city]]. The Kumumgah were rounded up as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] among them were culled.
